comments.author: Io
comments.body: Can I use the same fs part in one improvement? Or do I need to use a different kind and not repeat using the same one again?

comments.author: Llewelyn
comments.body: it's been my observation that using 2 identical parts in 1 mod has a high chance of a low result - in this example you'd be more likely to get turn +2 or +3 than +5. Not universal, some have used 2 items with good results, but my personal experience leads me now to avoid it and split the items over 2 mods
